candidate.label: Reuse mouse electronics with a remote pedal contact
candidate.rationale: Alternative for smaller foot interface or relocating electronics: original mouse remains USB endpoint, while a separate passive contact would actuate the chosen existing switch circuit. Requires topology and continuity evidence absent from S1/S2.

spec.approach: Protect original mouse electronics in enclosure; extend only an identified button-switch closure to a separately enclosed pedal contact.

decision_metrics.advance_if: Mapped donor topology plus suitable reclaimed switch/wire/enclosure and authorization exist; otherwise retain intact approach.
decision_metrics.electrical_intrusion: Requires soldering and reverse engineering later
decision_metrics.footprint: Potentially smaller pedal; no dimensions claimed
main_risks: Wrong switch nodes or non-dry-contact topology
No suitable reclaimed remote switch available

spec.donor_identity: Unknown discarded wired USB mouse; B100 is exemplar only

electrical_design.connection_rule: No pad numbers, common-ground assumption, pullup voltage or pinout asserted. Before a schematic, establish switch terminal function and open/closed topology with unpowered traceable evidence.
electrical_design.contact_rule: Only if evidence confirms an isolated dry-contact equivalent, propose a passive normally-open contact across the verified original button closure nodes. Never inject external voltage or connect USB supply/data wires to the pedal.
electrical_design.routing: Keep USB cable and electronics unchanged; evaluate added wire length, strain relief, short protection and switch bounce after donor evidence.

evidence_packet.limitation: No specimen exists; original HTML hashes are locator provenance only; HS page-addressed document inspection rejected Markdown with 422 PDF signature requirement.

spec.evidence_status: Document-only design proposal; physical correctness remains unproven. No physical actions permitted in this trial.

host_behavior.mapping: Use native application mouse-button binding if available. A keyboard-only target requires device-specific host remapping, subject to later OS/application evidence.
host_behavior.single_action: One target application action on the chosen button down transition; suppress repeat while held; re-arm after release.
host_behavior.unwanted_inputs: Mount against translation; shield unused buttons and wheel; verify zero unwanted pointer/wheel/other button actions in target use.

mechanical_design.load_path: Pedal chassis and hard stop carry foot load independently of the electrical switch.
mechanical_design.materials: Remote contact, wire and enclosure are requirements, not claimed available stock.

spec.system_boundary: Reuse original mouse USB cable/controller/firmware; no purchased development board and no firmware modification.
unknowns: Actual donor identity and functional state
Actual USB enumeration and button reports
Foot force, travel, return, slip resistance and useful service life
